en:
Bonus Scenario 3
"Abel"
A black-winged boy... could it be Abel?

jp: 可能性で言えばアリだな
en: It's possible, sure.

jp: 教会にインセストがいないか
探りに来ていたのかも
en: Maybe he came to check whether there's an Incest at the church?

jp: もしかしたら、マティアが・・・
en: Then maybe Matia is...
That's too simple a leap.

jp: 教会の近くで黒羽根を見たから
そこに必ずインセストがいるとは
en: A black-wing seen near a church doesn't mean there's an Incest there for sure.

jp: 無駄に動き回るのも賢明とは
en: ...True. Running around with nothing certain to go on can hardly be called wise.
I know, but...

jp: 様子だけでも見に行くか？
en: Well, if it's bugging you, wanna go take a look at least?

jp: あの教会なら、ここからそんなに
en: That church isn't that far from here, you know?
What should I do?
Never mind
I want to go
...Never mind.

jp: 無理しなくていいんだぜ？
気になるなら行けばいいだろ？
en: You don't have to force it, you know? If it's bugging you, just go.

jp: なんでもマティアと関連づけて
考えるのはよくないんだと思う
en: ...Yeah, but I don't think it's good to tie everything back to Matia.

jp: 窮地に立たされた時ほど
冷静な判断が必要なんだって
ヨハネが言ってたから・・・
en: Johannes said the tighter the spot, the more you need a cool head...

jp: 確かに言ったかもしれないが
感情を抑えて、気持ちの
整理ができればの話だ
en: I may have said so, but only if you can rein in your feelings and sort them out.

jp: 無理に感情を抑えたところで
冷静な判断はできないと
en: Forcing your feelings down will not give you a cool head, I think...

jp: 大丈夫、無理なんかしてないから
en: I'm totally fine. Really, I'm not forcing anything.

jp: 俺には無理してるようにしか
見えないんだけどなぁ・・・
en: Looks like forcing it to me, though...
No helping it, then.
...We're going.
Huh?

jp: 俺達はアラギの痕跡がないか
en: We're going to check for any trace of Aragi.

jp: 来るならお前達も勝手に
en: If you're coming, follow along. Suit yourselves.
Ah! Wait up, Zion!!

jp: 俺達も行くとしますか
en: Guess we're going too, then.
Yes, so it seems.
I want to go.

jp: マティアがそこにいたら・・・
en: If, just maybe, Matia is there...

jp: やっぱ、可能性はしらみつぶしに
当たった方がスッキリして
en: Yeah, best thing is to run down every lead one by one. Clears the head!

jp: 後で中途半端にもやもやした
気持ちにならずにすむしな
en: Beats being left half-sure and stewing on it later.

jp: 行こう＜ハルフォルト＞教会へ
en: Yeah. Let's go to Halfort Church.
Gyaaaaaah!!
...Hmph. Weak.

jp: 相手はたかが黒羽根の少年
en: D-damn it!! He's just one black-winged boy!!

jp: 大人しくインセストを出せば
en: Hand over the Incest quietly and I'll let you live.

jp: 別にオレは、皆殺しでも
en: I don't mind killing every last one of you, you know?

jp: このまま皆殺しになるか
インセストを差し出すか・・・
en: Well? All of you die here, or you give up the Incest...

jp: こんなとこで終わらせてたまる
en: ...Damn it!! I won't let it end in a place like this!!!

jp: インセストを差し出したところで
こいつが約束を守るとは
en: Even if we hand over the Incest, no way this one keeps his word...
In that case...
Answer. Now. Death, or submission?

jp: インセストをここに連れてこい！
en: ...Very well. Bring the Incest here!
Sir!!

jp: インセストを渡す瞬間をついて
en: The moment we hand over the Incest, we strike him all at once.

jp: しかし、それではインセストが
傷つくおそれが・・・
en: But sir, the Incest might be harmed...

jp: 不幸な事故で片付ければ良い
我々僧兵は、忌まわしき黒羽根の
en: Call it a tragic accident. We monk soldiers exist to slay the accursed black-wings.
...Sir!
What are you whispering about? Hurry up.

jp: すぐに連れて来てやる
en: ...Hmph. We'll bring her right away.
Come on, move it!!

jp: インセストを連れてきました！！
en: I've brought the Incest!!
Good work. That'll do. Stand back.

jp: そいつが＜インセスト＞か？
en: That's the Incest?
Yes. This girl bears the Invisible Hand of God. She is an Incest.
This girl's really an Incest, is she?
Hmph. Suspicious demon.

jp: ＜インセスト＞の服を脱がせろ！
en: You!! Strip the Incest!

jp: インセストなら身体のどこかに
＜神の見えざる手＞と呼ばれる
赤いアザがあるはずだ！！
en: An Incest bears a red mark somewhere on the body, called the Invisible Hand of God!!
Sir!!
No!!
Just bear with it. Hold still!!

jp: 女を渡せ、オレが確かめる
en: Enough!! Give her here. I'll check myself.

jp: インセストに刻まれた
＜咎人の証＞なら翼の付け根と
同じ場所にあるはずだ
en: The Mark of the Sinner carved on an Incest sits where the wings would root.

jp: フン、ならば勝手にしろ
en: Hmph. Suit yourself, then.

jp: お前は本当に＜インセスト＞か？
en: Answer honestly. Are you truly an Incest?

jp: オレの声が聞こえるはずだ
en: If you're an Incest, you should be able to hear my voice.
...Who are you...?
Now!! Attack!!
Damn!!
This is...

jp: どうやら一足遅かったみたいだね
en: Looks like we were a step too late.

jp: どの死体もほとんど正面から
剣でバッサリやられている
en: A massacre... Nearly every body was cut down head-on, with a sword.

jp: 少なくともアラギじゃないわね
アラギならもっと無駄のない
en: At least it wasn't Aragi. Aragi would have killed with far less wasted motion.

jp: 生きてる奴はいないのか！？
en: Damn it!! Is nobody alive!?
...Ugh. Is someone there?
A voice!?

jp: 手を、貸してくれ・・・
en: Help... give me a hand...

jp: 生きてる奴が・・・・・
en: Over here, there's still a few of us alive......
Are you... all right?
...Th-that face!? You're the demon from before!!?
Huh?

jp: 俺達に止めを刺しに戻って
en: What do you want now!? Come back to finish us off!?
N-no! I'm...

jp: これ以上、貴様に仲間達を
殺されてたまるものか！！
en: Damn you!! I won't let you kill any more of my comrades!!
Ugh... Koff, koff!!

jp: 無理に動いちゃダメだよ！！
en: You mustn't move like that!!

jp: 全ては貴様がやったこと
en: Shut up, black-wing!! This was all your doing!!

jp: 落ち着いてよく見てみろよ
そいつは黒羽根なんかじゃない
en: Hey, hey, old man. Calm down and take a good look. He's no black-wing.

jp: この顔はどう見てもさっきの
en: Don't be absurd!! That face is the black-wing's from before, plain as...

jp: 黒羽根じゃ、ない・・・？
どういうことだ、その顔は
確かに奴と同じ・・・
en: Not a... black-wing...? How? That face is the same as his, I'm sure...

jp: アベルがここに来たんだね？
アベルはいったい、ここで
en: Abel came here, didn't he? What did Abel do here?

jp: 突然、黒羽根の少年が現れ
僧兵達を次々と斬り殺していった
en: A black-winged boy appeared from nowhere and cut the monk soldiers down one by one.

jp: そして、奴にインセストの少女が
奪われてしまった・・・
en: And then he took the Incest girl from us...
It can't be... Matia...?

jp: さらわれたのは、どんな子！？
en: The girl he took, what was she like!? Her name...!?

jp: 名前は確か・・・レア
en: A blue-eyed girl... Her name was... Rea, I think.

jp: 違う、マティアじゃない・・
en: No... it's not Matia...

jp: 先を越されてしまったようだな
en: It seems we were beaten to it this time.
Yeah.

jp: でも、アベルはいったい
何のためにインセストを・・？
en: But what does Abel want with an Incest...?

jp: ヒャーハッハッハッハ！！
en: HYAA-HAHAHA!!

jp: 身をていして女を守るとは
お前も案外間抜けだな
en: Shielding a girl with your own body? You're a bigger fool than I thought.

jp: せっかく見つけたインセストだ
死体になられては意味がない
en: An Incest we finally found. She's no use as a corpse. That's all there is to it.
Kukuku. True enough.

jp: 人のことを言う暇があったら
＜適合者＞となるインセストでも
en: If you've got time to talk about me, go hunt an Incest to be your Compatible One.

jp: 余興のきかねぇヤツだな・・
どうせヤルなら面白い方法で
ヤったほうが楽しいぜ？
en: No sense of fun... If you're gonna do it anyway, do it in style. More fun, no?
Do as you like...

jp: あいつも目を覚ますさ
en: Kukuku... Once death is breathing down her neck, she'll wake up too.

jp: 人の血肉をすすってまで
生にしがみつくのか・・・
en: Hideous. Clinging to life even if it means slurping human flesh and blood...
Big talk... You're the same, aren't you?

jp: インセストの命をすすって
生きながらえるバケモノがよ！
en: A monster that lives on by sucking the life out of Incests!

jp: 生きるとは、死に対する
en: To live is nothing but an ugly struggle against death.

jp: だから、俺もお前も醜い・・・
ただそれだけのことだ
en: So you and I are both ugly... That is all there is to it.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
